title: Stroke: history or residual deficits
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's past stroke and any residual deficits.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for right-sided hemiparesis.

HPI
Pt is an 83-year-old female presenting for f/u of chronic right-sided hemiparesis secondary to a previous ischemic stroke. Pt reports stable mobility and functional status. She denies any recent falls or increased weakness. She continues to utilize assistive devices for ambulation. No new complaints voiced today.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3. 
Vitals: BP 132/84, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% RA.
Neuro: RRR, CTAB. Strength: 3/5 in right upper and lower extremities, 5/5 in left. Sensation intact throughout.
MSK: No acute joint swelling or erythema.

Assessment
1. Right-sided hemiparesis from past ischemic stroke. Stable condition.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Continue physical therapy for gait stability.
3. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/12/2026
explanations: Residual hemiparesis after an ischemic stroke, right side, dominant by default: I69.351 (HCC 253).

distractors.why: Check the documented handedness; when it is not documented, the right side is dominant and the left side non-dominant.
Residual hemiparesis is documented: code the sequela (I69.35-, HCC 253), not Z86.73.
